commands.bsc.readiness.start: fixed native read-only binary; lifecycle lock; durable UUID receipt; snapshot hash identity
commands.bsc.readiness.stop: SIGTERM current managed job only; no force kill
commands.bsc.candidate.select: offline G0.7 A/B candidate request only: fixed SELF_A|SELF_B resource, profile_version generation CAS, native g07_candidate request record; effective only after the native apply at the desktop bsc sync; never arm, sign or send
commands.bsc.source.mode.set: source and component mode request only: fixed BSC_INGRESS_* source or runtime component and OFF|SHADOW|LIVE as `<ID>:<MODE>` resource, config_version generation CAS, applied or refused by the native bsc_runtime owner with a durable receipt; a requested LIVE is effective only while the owner’s LIVE gate is clear (plan 28.10.); never arm, sign or send
commands.bsc.venue.mode.set: venue admission request only (plan v9 §2.3): fixed BSC_VENUE_FLAP|FOUR_CLASSIC|OPENFOUR and OFF|SHADOW|LIVE, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; Flap SHADOW admits to the C3 PAPER path and Strategy C, Four has no path (FOUR_EXECUTION_PATH_MISSING), a requested LIVE is effective only while the owner’s LIVE gate is clear (plan 28.10.); never arm, sign or send
commands.bsc.wallet.set: wallet switch request only (plan 27.10.): fixed BSC_WALLET_LAUNCHER|BUYER and DISABLED|ENABLED, wallet_policy_version CAS (the owner generation), the same native owner and receipt; DISABLED initially and after every restart; a permission every Mainnet signing/sending path checks, never a signature or send
commands.bsc.economic.set: economic switch request only (plan 27.10.): fixed BSC_ECON_SIGN|ARM|SEND|ATTEMPT|LIVE and DISABLED|ENABLED, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; DISABLED initially and after every restart; a permission its Mainnet path checks besides guard, V5, nonce, budget and attempt authority, never an action
commands.bsc.runtime.mode.set: global runtime mode request only (plan v9 §2.5): BSC_RUNTIME_MODE and OFF|SHADOW|PAPER|LIVE, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; SHADOW runs the Strategy C ledger, PAPER also the C3 path to the PAPER sink (PAPER identity, nothing sent), a requested LIVE is effective only while the owner’s LIVE gate is clear (plan 28.10.); never arm, sign or send
commands.bsc.attempt.limit.set: daily BUY attempt limit request only (plan 27.10., 8b4721bb): BSC_BUY_ATTEMPTS_PER_DAY and a plain decimal within u32, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; counts every attempt that may send per UTC day before its authority; 0 initially; never a permission to execute
commands.bsc.live.grant: LIVE grant request only (plan 28.10.): fixed BSC_LIVE_GRANT resource, BscLiveGrantCommand (Flap venue, strategies, ingress sources, builder adapters, plain wei limits, 1..=10 attempts, expiry) with the SHA-256 of the canonical scope text the operator confirmed, config_version CAS; the native owner recomputes the digest, valid only in this boot session until expiry; a grant is never a send: every intent is admitted by the owner's gate at its dispatch
commands.bsc.live.revoke: LIVE revoke request only (plan 28.10.): BSC_LIVE_GRANT:DISABLED, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; the LIVE path ends at its next pass and its key is dropped
commands.bsc.attempt.total.set: campaign total BUY attempt limit request only (plan 28.10.): BSC_BUY_ATTEMPTS_TOTAL and 0..=10, config_version CAS, the same native owner and receipt; every real BUY attempt counts over every day and restart, UNKNOWN ones too
